desks.title: Marlow Lane apartments — DD fee check before the variation goes in
desks.description: A 24-apartment job at design development: fee spent against fee earned by stage, a variation being worked on before it's signed, and the internal design review.
desks.brief:
## Marlow Lane — design development fee check

**Project** 24 apartments over a ground-floor tenancy · 5 storeys · client Tallow Developments
**Stage** Design development, 60% complete · **Base fee** $540,000 ex GST
**Team** Anika (director) · Tomás (project architect) · Wei and Hana (documentation)

### The problem
DD has used **$88,560 of its $108,000 fee — 82% of the budget at 60% complete** (492 hours at a blended $180). At this rate the stage finishes around $147,600. Most of the overrun is unit layouts redrawn twice after Tallow changed the apartment mix.

Separately, Tallow wants the ground floor to become a childcare centre instead of retail. That's Variation 03 ($24,000), and **$6,400 of V03 work is already booked without a signed variation**.

### Where the project stands
Spent to date $256,960 against $217,300 earned — **$39,660 ahead of the fee**. Concept and schematic both ran a little over, and V02 (the council RFI response) ran $1,400 over.

### This week
- V03 letter to Tallow, signed before any more childcare work
- Internal design review of the DD set @+2d
- Re-plan the last 40% of DD: 108 hours of budget left

callout.title: No more V03 work until it's signed
callout.body: $6,400 of childcare redesign is already booked against an unsigned variation. Tomás pauses it today, and Anika takes the letter to Tallow @+1d. If they won't sign, the ground floor stays as retail in the DD set.

children.label: Does childcare need a new approval?
Freeze unit layouts at the review
Bin room door onto the driveway

blocks.p: To Tallow Developments. Following your instruction to change the ground-floor tenancy from retail to a childcare centre, this letter sets out the additional services, the fee and the effect on timing.

ul: Redesign of the ground floor for a 90-place centre, including outdoor play space
Coordination with the acoustic and traffic consultants for the new use
Revised DD drawings and area schedule
Advice on the planning approval the change of use may need

blocks.p: **$24,000 ex GST**, lump sum, invoiced 50% on signing and 50% when the revised DD set issues. Work completed to date ($6,400) is included in this sum.
Adds three weeks to design development. The start of contract documentation moves by the same amount.

blocks.quote: We'll pause further work on the childcare redesign until this variation is signed, so the rest of the DD set keeps moving.

notes.title: DD design review — pin-up notes
notes.body:
Internal review @+2d, 45 minutes, Anika chairing.

- Balconies on levels 2–4 are 2.2m deep; the brief asked for 2.4m. Check against living-room depth before we change it
- Bin room door opens straight onto the driveway — needs a second look with traffic
- Façade rhythm breaks at the corner; Tomás has two options to pin up
- Lift overrun shows on the street elevation — can it drop?
- Unit 3.04 has a bedroom on borrowed light only. Must fix

stickies.title: Today
stickies.body:
1. Pause V03 work
2. Variation letter to Anika
3. Pin-up set printed by 4pm

stickies.title: Fee rule
stickies.body: Never start a variation before it's signed. We did. Again.

desks.title: Juniper Street townhouses — DA lodgement in 9 days
desks.description: Coordinating nine consultants for a development application: who owes what, the council's pre-lodgement feedback, and the materials palette the planner will judge.
desks.brief:
## Juniper Street townhouses — DA package

**Project** 6 townhouses on a corner block · client Hollis Family Trust · Tomás leading, Hana supporting
**DA lodgement** @+9d · **Planning controls** 9.5m height, 0.8:1 floor space ratio
**Site** 1,150 m² · **GFA** 897 m², so 0.78:1
**Council pre-lodgement** held two weeks ago — notes on this desk

### Where the package stands
Four of twelve items are in. The landscape plan is overdue, and the acoustic and energy reports haven't started because both are waiting on our window schedule. That schedule is the real critical path: **it has to reach Marco and Ines by @+1d** or neither report makes lodgement.

### What council told us
- Keep all three street trees — the arborist report supports it
- One driveway crossover only, on the secondary street
- Materials should respond to the brick and timber character of the street
- The 4.5m rear setback is under the 6m control and needs a written justification

### Done means
Twelve items received, every consultant comment closed, drawings and reports on the same revision, and the package lodged @+9d.

callout.title: Critical path: our window schedule
callout.body: Acoustic and energy both need final window sizes and glazing. Hana finishes the schedule today and it goes to Marco and Ines @+1d. Marco needs three days and Ines four, so every day it slips comes straight off the buffer before lodgement.

blocks.p: With council's duty planner and tree officer, two weeks ago, 45 minutes. Rhea attended for planning; Anika and Tomás for the studio.

ul: Supportive of six dwellings if the three street trees stay
One driveway crossover only, on the secondary street
Rear setback of 4.5m is under the 6m control — needs a written justification
Materials should pick up the brick and timber of the existing houses
Bins collected from the kerb and stored behind the building line
Arborist report confirms all three trees can stay, with root protection zones
One crossover on the secondary street — traffic report to confirm the 3.6m width
Rhea's statement of environmental effects carries the setback justification
Materials palette on this desk: recycled brick, spotted gum, bronze frames, zinc roof

blocks.p: Whether council wants a heritage comment on the brick colour. Rhea is asking the duty planner.

notes.title: Consultant call — what changed
notes.body:
Weekly coordination call, 30 minutes.

- Grace: traffic report needs the crossover width confirmed — 3.6m
- Omar: landscape plan late because the tree protection zones moved the paths; now promised @+1d
- Felix: cost estimate in; the client wants a version without the green roof
- Dev: stormwater fine, but the tank sits under the courtyard deck — check with landscape
- Ines: the thermal assessment produces the BASIX certificate that goes in with the DA, so it also waits on our glazing
- Next call @+7d, two days before lodgement

stickies.title: Today
stickies.body:
1. Window schedule finished
2. Chase Omar
3. Courier the brick to the client

stickies.title: Lodgement rule
stickies.body: Every drawing and report on the same revision letter before it goes in.
